task: Search for a high-protein vegetarian chili recipe on Allrecipes that has at least 50 reviews and a rating of 4 stars or higher. Provide the ingredient list, cooking time, and a brief description of the cooking steps.
answer:
Recipe: Meatiest Vegetarian Chili from Your Slow Cooker (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/132394/meatiest-vegetarian-chili-from-your-slow-cooker/) — Rating: 4.6 stars, 232 reviews (meets ≥4 stars and ≥50 reviews). High-protein vegetarian chili with 21g protein per serving from tofu and black beans.

INGREDIENTS: 1/2 cup olive oil; 4 onions, chopped; 2 green bell peppers, seeded and chopped; 2 red bell peppers, seeded and chopped; 1 (14 oz) package firm tofu, drained and cubed; 4 cloves garlic, minced; 4 (15.5 oz) cans black beans, drained; 2 (15 oz) cans crushed tomatoes; 6 tablespoons chili powder; 2 tablespoons dried oregano; 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar; 1 tablespoon liquid hot pepper sauce (e.g., Tabasco); 2 teaspoons ground cumin; 2 teaspoons salt; 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper.

COOKING TIME: Prep 25 mins; Cook 6 hrs 15 mins; Total 6 hrs 40 mins.

COOKING STEPS (brief): 1) Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; sauté onions until softening, then add bell peppers, cubed tofu, and garlic and cook until vegetables are lightly browned and tender (~10 minutes). 2) Place drained black beans in a slow cooker, add the tofu-vegetable mixture and crushed tomatoes, stir in chili powder, oregano, vinegar, hot pepper sauce, cumin, salt, and pepper; cover and cook on Low for 6 to 8 hours.
